release_invariants.rule: Every executable worker run must carry an explicit canonical assay/profile identity. Development mode may expose engineering diagnostics but may not synthesize assay identity from unprofiled defaults.

Changing Scientific-Strict to development may alter engineering diagnostics or qualification posture, but must not change assay identity, polymerase/chemistry, required purpose, hard/bounded parameter authority, topology, or named protocol semantics.
A failed or unavailable PRIMARY scientific backend must not be silently replaced by a different algorithm.
Candidate search may broaden only inside the same legal assay envelope; hard assay gates are never relaxed to obtain a result.
A different polymerase, buffer or reaction condition requires a named, sourced and versioned chemistry/profile rather than an anonymous override.
A multi-purpose assay must receive an explicit purpose or a versioned profile default; generic purpose is never guessed.
Specificity uses an explicitly declared annealing_sequence; a tailed/composite ordered oligo is never guessed to be its own annealing core.
Production/approved-reference BLAST and MFEprimer evidence requires a versioned source FASTA plus matching index-artifact fingerprints.
Ranking heuristics may rank candidates only after scientific gates; they cannot create or weaken assay validity.
UI/API modifiers are advertised only when the complete assay semantics are implemented, not because a lower-level engine can approximate part of them.
Sequence design and in-silico evidence never imply wet-lab validation, LOD/LOQ, efficiency, Cq, threshold, cluster separation or diagnostic performance.
When required scientific context or a validated implementation branch is absent, typed refusal or evidence-incomplete is preferred to inference or fallback.

A tool bound as OPTIONAL or REFERENCE may add advisory evidence only; its presence or absence must not change hard validity, deterministic candidate ranking, or the default selected candidate. If it participates in a decision, promote it to an explicit required engine role and qualification gate.

When cycling or bench chemistry is kit/platform/protocol-specific, PCRStudio must require or preserve that named authority and may not synthesize a generic bench programme from primer Tm, product length, or a surrogate polymerase preset.
